The data clearly shows Zone_F2_Z01's cooling temperature setpoint dropped from ~24.0 °C to ~23.0 °C starting mid-June 2018 (June 19), while every other zone's setpoint remained unchanged. The zone temperature followed the setpoint down by ~1 °C during occupied hours.

This signature — a single zone's setpoint moving while all other zones (and the base schedule values) stayed constant — is characteristic of a local override / controller offset applied to that zone, not a change to the shared schedule.
